tasks.label: commit_and_push
tasks.command: stamp=$(python3 -c "import datetime;d=datetime.datetime.now();print(d.strftime('%Y_%m%d_%H%M')+'_%03d'%(d.microsecond//1000))") && git add -A && if git diff --cached --quiet; then echo "nothing to commit"; else git commit -m "$stamp" && git push origin HEAD; fi
